notes: OTA self-update now actually completes (this was the real 'says updating but nothing changes' bug). Rebuilt the swap after testing it end-to-end against a real locked 26 MB exe: 'errorlevel' after 'move' is unreliable in a console-less batch (so it neither swapped nor rolled back - it just died), and goto-inside-parens corrupts cmd parsing. The swap now uses flat control flow and detects success by whether the new file was consumed by the move - proven to complete. Install this build once (manually) to get onto the fixed updater; updates from here on will apply on their own.
